name: Exp_Daniella
summary: Exp_Daniella is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies directional momentum and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of moving average-based trend detection and momentum confirmation to generate entry signals, with built-in stop loss and take profit management. The EA applies systematic position sizing and trailing stop logic to manage risk and lock in profits as trends develop.
summary_zh: Exp_Daniella是一个趋势跟踪型EA，通过识别方向性动量并沿当前趋势方向入场交易。它结合基于均线的趋势检测和动量确认来生成入场信号，内置止损和止盈管理功能。该EA采用系统化的仓位管理和追踪止损逻辑来控制风险并在趋势发展时锁定利润。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是识别市场的主导趋势方向并在趋势延续时入场。入场条件通常基于移动平均线的交叉或价格与均线的关系来判断趋势方向，并配合动量指标如RSI或MACD进行确认，确保趋势具有足够的强度。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈水平，以及追踪止损机制，当价格朝有利方向移动时逐步收紧止损以保护浮动利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，确保每笔交易的风险在可控范围内。资金管理方面，EA设置了最大持仓限制和回撤控制，防止在不利行情中过度暴露风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，但作为趋势跟踪系统，在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy where the core concept is identifying the dominant market trend direction and entering trades when the trend is expected to continue. Entry conditions are typically based on moving average crossovers or price-to-MA relationships to determine trend direction, combined with momentum indicators such as RSI or MACD for confirmation that the trend has sufficient strength. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, along with a trailing stop mechanism that progressively tightens the stop as price moves favorably to protect unrealized profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or proportion-based calculations tied to account balance, ensuring risk per trade remains within controlled boundaries. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and drawdown controls to prevent excessive exposure during unfavorable market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear and systematic, but as a trend-following system, it may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，趋势跟踪是经过验证的长期有效方法
内置追踪止损机制，能有效保护浮动利润并优化盈利表现
具有止损和止盈设置，风险参数透明可控
系统化交易消除情绪干扰，执行纪律性强
pros_en: Clear strategy logic - trend following is a proven long-term effective approach
Built-in trailing stop mechanism effectively protects unrealized profits and optimizes profitability
Stop loss and take profit settings provide transparent and controllable risk parameters
Systematic trading eliminates emotional interference with strong execution discipline
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤器，无法自动区分趋势市和震荡市
固定参数设置可能不适应所有市场环境，缺乏自适应机制
没有多时间周期确认，可能在小周期噪音中错误入场
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks market regime filter to automatically distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Fixed parameter settings may not adapt well to all market environments, lacking self-adaptive mechanisms
No multi-timeframe confirmation may lead to erroneous entries from lower timeframe noise
improvements: 增加市场状态识别过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡行情中自动暂停交易
引入多时间周期分析框架，用高周期趋势确认低周期入场信号
improvements_en: Add a market regime identification filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to automatically pause trading during ranging conditions
Introduce a multi-timeframe analysis framework to confirm lower timeframe entry signals with higher timeframe trend direction

risk_points: 趋势跟踪在震荡市中会产生连续亏损，缺乏市场状态切换机制
追踪止损参数设置不当可能导致盈利过早离场或保护不足
risk_points_en: Trend following produces consecutive losses in ranging markets without a regime-switching mechanism
Improper trailing stop parameter settings may lead to premature profit exits or insufficient protection

summary_en: Exp_Daniella is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies directional momentum and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of moving average-based trend detection and momentum confirmation to generate entry signals, with built-in stop loss and take profit management. The EA applies systematic position sizing and trailing stop logic to manage risk and lock in profits as trends develop.
